title: Dogfood install as-is in BotSpy after Pudicus ships
description: BotSpy already has a separately installed Pudicus integration. The newly hardened source has not implicitly upgraded it. Pending: review the existing custom policy, interpreter, receipt gate, hook configuration and all active siblings; then adopt the reviewed published GitBouncer build with legacy compatibility and synthetic clean/blocked/error tests. Preserve existing hooks and policy. No rollout has been performed by this task. This issue depends on product publication; it is not complete.
